column1: # species_map.tsv — Mapping from MAF species codes to clean phylogenetic names.
# Verified against inspect_maf.py output on the Fontaine 2015 reference-
# This produces a 7-taxon alignment per locus:
# AgamP3 (PEST) is the alignment anchor and is NOT included as a phylogenetic
# taxon — including it would create a near-duplicate of AgamS1/AgamM1 and
# AepiE1 (epiroticus) is excluded as a second outgroup; Fontaine showed the
# choice of outgroup didn't matter, and one is cleaner pedagogically.
